executive_summary: Comprehensive overview of Introduction to Aksha
key_value_propositions: Aksha is an intelligent surveillance system designed for automated monitoring with minimal human intervention.
Utilizes advanced technologies such as Computer Vision, Artificial Intelligence, and Generative AI for real-time analysis.
Capable of detecting objects and unusual situations, enhancing situational awareness and security.
strategic_insights: Live recording and processing of surveillance data for immediate insights.
Advanced object detection capabilities, including identifying people, vehicles, and specific anomalies.
Customizable alerts that empower users to respond promptly to critical events.
actionable_recommendations: Supports multiple deployment architectures: On-Premise, Edge, and Cloud solutions.
Decoupled architecture enhances fault tolerance and maintainability.
Effortless scalability through microservices and real-time data processing capabilities.
